get_default_config: get the default AlphaMissense model configuration as a ConfigDict by calling model_config with no arguments
get_model_variant_config: get a specific AlphaMissense model variant configuration by calling model_config with a name like model_3
inspect_evoformer_settings: inspect the evoformer block settings including attention heads, dropout rates, and transition parameters in CONFIG_MISSENSE
inspect_structure_module_settings: inspect the structure module settings including channel sizes, layer counts, and sidechain parameters in CONFIG_MISSENSE
inspect_global_config: inspect the global configuration settings including bfloat16 mode, multimer mode, and recycling settings in CONFIG_MISSENSE
